help.message:
QQBot commands:
/list [server] view online players
/tps [server] view server performance
/ping [gameID/server] view latency
/bind <gameID> bind game account
/unbind unbind game account
/me view my binding
tps.no_bridge: No backend server connected, cannot get TPS
bind.code_sent: Please use account %s and run /bind accept %s in game (code valid for 5 minutes)
bind.accept.expired: Verification code expired, please bind again in QQ
bind.accept.mismatch: Verification code does not match current gameID
bind.accept.bound_by_other: This gameID has been bound by another QQ
bind.notify: Your QQ has been bound to gameID: %s
unbind.not_bound: You have not bound a gameID
unbind.game.not_bound: You have not bound a gameID
unbind.notify: Your QQ has been unbound from gameID: %s
me.not_bound: You have not bound a gameID
reminder.bound_join: Your bound account %s is online on server %s
